spec.description: Detailed host and container diagnostics for Domibus performance testing. Use this dashboard to inspect CPU, memory, filesystem, disk and network behavior for red/blue AP hosts and their Docker containers. Set the time range to the Run window when analyzing a test.

spec.title: Host CPU Now
spec.description: Current host CPU utilization for the selected AP instance(s).

spec.title: Host Memory Now
spec.description: Current host memory utilization based on MemAvailable.

spec.title: Container CPU Now
spec.description: Current CPU cores consumed by selected containers.

spec.title: Container Memory Now
spec.description: Current working-set memory for selected containers.

spec.title: Host CPU Utilization
spec.description: Total host CPU utilization per selected AP.

spec.title: Host Load Average
spec.description: Linux 1, 5 and 15 minute load averages.

spec.title: Host Memory Utilization
spec.description: Host memory utilization based on MemAvailable / MemTotal.

spec.title: Host Available Memory
spec.description: Absolute memory still available to the operating system.

spec.title: Filesystem Utilization
spec.description: Host filesystem utilization. Temporary/pseudo filesystems are excluded.

spec.title: Filesystem Available Space
spec.description: Available bytes on relevant host filesystems.

spec.title: Host Disk Throughput
spec.description: Aggregate host disk read/write throughput.

spec.title: Host Disk IOPS
spec.description: Completed host disk read/write operations per second.

spec.title: Host Disk Average I/O Time
spec.description: Average observed I/O service time per completed read/write operation.

spec.title: Host Network Throughput
spec.description: Aggregate host network receive/transmit throughput, excluding loopback and common Docker virtual interfaces.

spec.title: Host Network Packets
spec.description: Host network packet rate.

spec.title: Host Network Errors / Drops
spec.description: Host network error/drop rates. Zero is expected during healthy Runs.

spec.title: Container CPU
spec.description: CPU cores consumed by selected containers. Domibus currently has no Docker CPU quota in the baseline.

spec.title: Container Working Set Memory
spec.description: Working-set memory of selected containers. Domibus currently has no Docker memory limit in the baseline.

spec.title: Container RSS
spec.description: Resident set size reported by cAdvisor.

spec.title: Container OOM Events
spec.description: Out-of-memory events. Any non-zero value during a Run requires investigation.

spec.title: Container Filesystem Throughput
spec.description: Container filesystem read/write throughput from cAdvisor.

spec.title: Container Network Throughput
spec.description: Container-level network receive/transmit throughput from cAdvisor.

spec.title: Container Network Errors / Drops
spec.description: Container network error/drop rates from cAdvisor.

spec.title: Selected Container Inventory
spec.description: cAdvisor inventory for selected named containers.

spec.title: 02 — Domibus · Host & Container Resources
